001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007import java.util.Set;
008import java.util.TreeSet;
009
010/**
011 * FreeStyle Libre 2 CGM data sample.
012 *
013 * The layout differs from the Dexcom records ({@link DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog}, {@link DexcomG7CGMHistoryLog}):
014 * the glucose value status and CGM data type are single bytes, the rate of change is a signed 16-bit
015 * value, and there is no transmitter timestamp. Field layout per the Tandem Source event schema:
016 * <pre>
017 *  0  uint8   glucoseValueStatus
018 *  1  uint8   cgmDataType (bitmask)
019 *  2  int16   rate (mg/dL/min)
020 *  4  uint8   algorithmState
021 *  5  int8    rssi (dBm)
022 *  6  uint16  currentGlucoseDisplayValue (mg/dL)
023 *  8  uint32  egvTimestamp (seconds)
024 * 12  uint16  egvInfoBitmask
025 * 14  uint8   interval
026 * 15  uint8   reserved
027 * </pre>
028 */
029@HistoryLogProps(
030    opCode = 372,
031    displayName = "CGM Data (FSL2)",
032    internalName = "LID_CGM_DATA_FSL2"
033)
034public class CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
035
036    private int glucoseValueStatusRaw;
037    private int cgmDataTypeRaw;
038    private int rate;
039    private int algorithmStateRaw;
040    private int rssi;
041    private int currentGlucoseDisplayValue;
042    private long egvTimestamp;
043    private int egvInfoBitmaskRaw;
044    private int interval;
045
046    public CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog() {}
047    public CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
048        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
049    }
050
051    public CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmStateRaw, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long egvTimestamp, int egvInfoBitmaskRaw, int interval) {
052        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
053        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmStateRaw, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, egvTimestamp, egvInfoBitmaskRaw, interval);
054        parse(cargo);
055    }
056
057    public CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog(int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmStateRaw, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long egvTimestamp, int egvInfoBitmaskRaw, int interval) {
058        this(0, 0, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmStateRaw, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, egvTimestamp, egvInfoBitmaskRaw, interval);
059    }
060
061    public int typeId() {
062        return 372;
063    }
064
065    /**
066     * <table border="1">
067     * <caption>Parsed fields for CgmDataFsl2HistoryLog:</caption>
068     * <tr><td><code>glucoseValueStatusRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
069     * <tr><td><code>cgmDataTypeRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
070     * <tr><td><code>rate</code></td><td><code>(short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
071     * <tr><td><code>algorithmStateRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[14] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
072     * <tr><td><code>rssi</code></td><td><code>raw[15]</code></td></tr>
073     * <tr><td><code>currentGlucoseDisplayValue</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
074     * <tr><td><code>egvTimestamp</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
075     * <tr><td><code>egvInfoBitmaskRaw</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
076     * <tr><td><code>interval</code></td><td><code>raw[24] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
077     * </table>
078     */
079    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
080        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
081        this.cargo = raw;
082        parseBase(raw);
083        this.glucoseValueStatusRaw = raw[10] & 0xFF;
084        this.cgmDataTypeRaw = raw[11] & 0xFF;
085        this.rate = (short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
086        this.algorithmStateRaw = raw[14] & 0xFF;
087        this.rssi = raw[15];
088        this.currentGlucoseDisplayValue = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
089        this.egvTimestamp = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
090        this.egvInfoBitmaskRaw = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
091        this.interval = raw[24] & 0xFF;
092    }
093
094    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
095        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
096    }
097
098    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmStateRaw, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long egvTimestamp, int egvInfoBitmaskRaw, int interval) {
099        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
100            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(372, 0), // 372 = 0x0174
101            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
102            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
103            new byte[]{(byte) glucoseValueStatusRaw},
104            new byte[]{(byte) cgmDataTypeRaw},
105            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(rate & 0xFFFF),
106            new byte[]{(byte) algorithmStateRaw},
107            new byte[]{(byte) rssi},
108            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentGlucoseDisplayValue),
109            Bytes.toUint32(egvTimestamp),
110            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(egvInfoBitmaskRaw),
111            new byte[]{(byte) interval},
112            new byte[]{0}));
113    }
114
115    public enum GlucoseValueStatus {
116        PRECISE_VALUE(0),
117        SPECIAL_HIGH(1),
118        SPECIAL_LOW(2)
119
120        ;
121        private int id;
122        GlucoseValueStatus(int id) {
123            this.id = id;
124        }
125
126        public static GlucoseValueStatus fromId(int id) {
127            for (GlucoseValueStatus r : values()) {
128                if (r.id == id) {
129                    return r;
130                }
131            }
132            return null;
133        }
134
135        public int getId() {
136            return id;
137        }
138    }
139
140    /**
141     * Bitmask describing the type of reading. Unlike the Dexcom records, Libre readings
142     * can also be one-minute readings (OMR).
143     */
144    public enum CgmDataType {
145        FIVE_MINUTE_READING(1),
146        BACKFILL(2),
147        NONE(16),
148        ONE_MINUTE_READING(32)
149
150        ;
151        private int id;
152        CgmDataType(int id) {
153            this.id = id;
154        }
155
156        public static Set<CgmDataType> fromId(int mask) {
157            Set<CgmDataType> items = new TreeSet<>();
158            for (CgmDataType i : values()) {
159                if ((mask & i.getId()) != 0) {
160                    items.add(i);
161                }
162            }
163            return items;
164        }
165
166        public int getId() {
167            return id;
168        }
169    }
170
171    public enum AlgorithmState {
172        WARMUP(2),
173        OK(100),
174        RF_ERROR(101),
175        SENSOR_SIGNAL_LOW(102),
176        TEMP_HIGH(103),
177        TEMP_LOW(104),
178        INVALID_DATA(105),
179        OTHER_DQ(106),
180        EGV_UNUSABLE(107)
181
182        ;
183        private int id;
184        AlgorithmState(int id) {
185            this.id = id;
186        }
187
188        public static AlgorithmState fromId(int id) {
189            for (AlgorithmState r : values()) {
190                if (r.id == id) {
191                    return r;
192                }
193            }
194            return null;
195        }
196
197        public int getId() {
198            return id;
199        }
200    }
201
202    /**
203     * EGV info bitmask. Bits 11-13 encode the sensor type (2 = Libre 2, 4 = Libre 3), see {@link #getSensorType()}.
204     */
205    public enum EgvInfo {
206        FIVE_MINUTE_READING(1),
207        BACKFILL(2),
208        NO_EGV(16),
209        VALID_TIMESTAMP(32),
210        VALID_EGV_RANGE(64),
211        VALID_ALG_STATE(128),
212        EGV_PROCESSED(256),
213        ONE_MINUTE_READING(512)
214
215        ;
216        private int id;
217        EgvInfo(int id) {
218            this.id = id;
219        }
220
221        public static Set<EgvInfo> fromId(int mask) {
222            Set<EgvInfo> items = new TreeSet<>();
223            for (EgvInfo i : values()) {
224                if ((mask & i.getId()) != 0) {
225                    items.add(i);
226                }
227            }
228            return items;
229        }
230
231        public int getId() {
232            return id;
233        }
234    }
235
236    public int getGlucoseValueStatusRaw() {
237        return glucoseValueStatusRaw;
238    }
239    public GlucoseValueStatus getGlucoseValueStatus() {
240        return GlucoseValueStatus.fromId(glucoseValueStatusRaw);
241    }
242    public int getCgmDataTypeRaw() {
243        return cgmDataTypeRaw;
244    }
245    public Set<CgmDataType> getCgmDataType() {
246        return CgmDataType.fromId(cgmDataTypeRaw);
247    }
248    /**
249     * Signed rate of change, in mg/dL per minute.
250     */
251    public int getRate() {
252        return rate;
253    }
254    public int getAlgorithmStateRaw() {
255        return algorithmStateRaw;
256    }
257    public AlgorithmState getAlgorithmState() {
258        return AlgorithmState.fromId(algorithmStateRaw);
259    }
260    /**
261     * Signed RSSI, in dBm.
262     */
263    public int getRssi() {
264        return rssi;
265    }
266    /**
267     * @return the glucose value in mg/dL
268     */
269    public int getCurrentGlucoseDisplayValue() {
270        return currentGlucoseDisplayValue;
271    }
272    public long getEgvTimestamp() {
273        return egvTimestamp;
274    }
275    public int getEgvInfoBitmaskRaw() {
276        return egvInfoBitmaskRaw;
277    }
278    public Set<EgvInfo> getEgvInfo() {
279        return EgvInfo.fromId(egvInfoBitmaskRaw);
280    }
281    /**
282     * @return the sensor type encoded in bits 11-13 of the EGV info bitmask (2 = Libre 2, 4 = Libre 3)
283     */
284    public int getSensorType() {
285        return (egvInfoBitmaskRaw >> 11) & 0x7;
286    }
287    public int getInterval() {
288        return interval;
289    }
290
291    /** @deprecated use {@link #getGlucoseValueStatusRaw()} */
292    @Deprecated
293    public int getStatus() {
294        return glucoseValueStatusRaw;
295    }
296    /** @deprecated use {@link #getCgmDataTypeRaw()} */
297    @Deprecated
298    public int getType() {
299        return cgmDataTypeRaw;
300    }
301    /** @deprecated use {@link #getCurrentGlucoseDisplayValue()} */
302    @Deprecated
303    public int getValue() {
304        return currentGlucoseDisplayValue;
305    }
306    /** @deprecated use {@link #getEgvTimestamp()} */
307    @Deprecated
308    public long getTimestamp() {
309        return egvTimestamp;
310    }
311}
